formalObservation.Composition:
A large composite figure occupies most of the central and lower portion of the page.

The composition contains:

- vertically oriented central form
- large lower animal-like body
- several appendages extending laterally
- circular forms
- rectangular enclosing field

The lower portion is dominated by a large horizontal body-like structure.
formalObservation.Primary Forms:
- Large horizontally oriented animal-like form
- Central vertically oriented rectangular/organic form
- Lateral curved appendages
- Rectangular framing structure
formalObservation.Visible Anatomical Features:
Lower figure:

- eye
- mouth
- multiple triangular tooth-like marks
- tail-like extension
- four small lower circular forms functioning visually as supports or feet

Central upper form:

- two vertically arranged circular eye-like forms
- surrounding rectangular/elongated structure
formalObservation.Structural Forms:
- Large rectangular frame
- Central vertical form
- Curved lateral extensions
- Horizontal lower body
- Circular lower supports
- Overlapping forms
formalObservation.Repeated Forms:
- Circular forms
- Paired / repeated eyes
- Triangular marks inside mouths
- Curved appendages
- Parallel hatching
formalObservation.Mark-Making:
- dense parallel hatching
- broad charcoal contours
- dark filled areas
- overlapping linear strokes
- repeated directional marks

The hatching is more extensive than in VL-B-001 and occupies substantial portions of the central forms.
formalObservation.Figure–Ground Relationship: The central composite figure is strongly separated from the white ground through heavy contour and hatching.
formalObservation.Formal Language:
- Large-scale composite construction.
- Multiple forms physically overlap.
- Circular units recur across different parts of the composition.
- Hatching establishes both surface and structural boundaries.
- Horizontal and vertical axes intersect within the composition.
- Anatomical and geometric forms are combined within a single figure.
